services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: The Learn-to-Swim course consists of six levels, focused on teaching school-age children and young teenagers how to swim skillfully and safely. Each level builds on information and skills from the previous level, promoting success and a positive learning experience. The recommended minimum age for entry into Learn-to-Swim is approximately 6 years old. There is no maximum age for any level; however, it is typical that participants in the Learn-to-Swim levels are elementary- to middle school-age children.
